text.tspan: 4 | Local opportunity accounts for much of the PTM overlap
A: Protein-level observed-minus-expected close-pair fractions at radius 10; boxes show median/IQR, whiskers 1.5 IQR, dots outliers. Cohorts differ; K-based
modifications use different eligible residues. C: All 465 paired protein shifts in high-scoring kinase count; teal marks archived mean and 95% CI. D: Primary
local controls; all 12 remain in S2. Static co-occurrence does not establish competition.
